name: ECS-48S-PoE
title: Switch Enterprise Campus 48S PoE
summary: 1U 48-port PoE+++ (90W) L3 access switch: 32x 2.5GbE + 16x 10GbE, 4x 25G uplinks, 100G stacking.

requires: UniFi OS console / gateway running UniFi Network (10.6.101+)

extra.qsfp28_note: 2x 100G QSFP28 are stacking-only, no uplink, no breakout

gotchas: PoE budget depends on mains and PSU mode: 2,150W at 240V shared but 1,750W at 120V and only 750W in 120V redundant mode — far below 48x90W.
The 2x 100G QSFP28 are stacking-only; real uplink capacity is 4x 25G SFP28 (100G) for 16x10G + 32x2.5G = 3:1+ oversubscribed.
Stacking only with same-port-count ECS switches, max 4 per stack.
Full-depth 1U with 4 hot-swap fans — equipment-room noise/depth; 4-post rack required.
Needs UniFi Network 10.6.101+; older self-hosted controllers can't adopt it.
best_for: high-density WiFi 7 / 90W PoE (PTZ, displays, lighting) campus closets
not_for: 120V single-circuit closets expecting full PoE budget
